title: Iran Goldstein escalation leads ITA
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Iran GDELT Goldstein 10d z-score < -1 (escalation) leads defense ETF returns by 2-5 days (+); trade long ITA 5d [gdelt.irn.goldstein -> finance.ITA.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.goldstein rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ITA next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Reversal control: Iran GDELT Goldstein 20d z-score > 1 (de-escalation) leads defense ETF returns by 1-3 days (-); trade short ITA 1d [gdelt.irn.goldstein -> finance.ITA.log_return] (parent: R2-0080)
